headword: {異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}

definitions.gloss: exotic atmosphere; foreign flavor (of a place)
definitions.explanation: The feeling of being somewhere foreign that a place gives off, through its buildings, streets, food, or customs. Said above all of Japanese port towns with a long history of foreign contact.

examples.japanese: {異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}あふれる⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧。
examples.english: A town brimming with exotic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: An exotic atmosphere hangs over the streets of Nagasaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北野|きたの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{洋館|ようかん}→洋館：30736_youkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}び→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧、{異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}できる→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: Old Western-style houses line the streets of Kitano in Kobe, and you can stroll there taking in the foreign atmosphere.

notes:
⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧ (foreign country) + ⟦{情緒|じょうちょ}→情緒：09058_joucho⟧ (atmosphere, mood). A travel-brochure favorite for ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧, ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧ and ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧, where Western and Chinese influence shapes the townscape. ⟦{情緒|じょうちょ}→情緒：09058_joucho⟧ is also read じょうしょ.

- {異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}あふれる: full of exotic atmosphere
- {異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧: an exotic air hangs over (a place)
- {異国情緒|いこくじょうちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧: to enjoy the foreign atmosphere
